title: [Performance] Enable fused MiniMax sparse prepare through 256K tokens
body:
### What this PR does / why we need it

Forward-port of #18660 to `main`.

MiniMax-M3's fused sparse-prepare path currently falls back to the separate Q/K normalization, RoPE, and cache-insertion chain whenever a batch contains more than 512 tokens. Raise the validated routing limit to 262144 tokens so prefill can use `minimax_qknorm_rope_cache`. Requests beyond the validated range retain the existing fallback.

### Does this PR introduce any user-facing change?

No configuration change is required. Supported MiniMax-M3 BF16 NPU prefill batches up to 256K tokens now use the existing fused QK-norm/RoPE/cache-insert kernel.

### How was this patch tested?

- Patch is identical to #18660 (`git patch-id --stable`)
- Release branch validation: `pytest -q tests/ut/models/minimax_m3/test_fused_sparse_prepare.py` (`23 passed`)
- A3 large-prefill correctness and latency validation at 32K, 64K, 128K, and 256K tokens
- Runtime validation with MiniMax-M3 prefill chunk size 2048
- The `main` forward-port was not separately rerun, per request
- vLLM main: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/commit/c4df37dfcc7f72ca41cd43801a468526ecf99a2b
